items.summary: Higher rates can feed trading activity while pressuring valuations, financing and the deal pipeline.

items.title: Mamdani Bans 600,000 NYC Students From Using AI, Days After Trump Says Towns Fighting AI Will Be “Backwards and Poor”
items.summary: New York City just locked hundreds of thousands of students out of AI tools for a full school year, setting up a direct collision with a White House warning that communities resisting the technology will pay an economic price.

items.title: Goldman Sachs, BofA Among 21 Banks Planning Joint Dollar Stablecoin Launch
items.summary: The bank-led consortium wants a U.S. dollar token live by the first half of 2027, with a euro version queued up next.

items.title: Fed Rate Decision: Goldman Versus Citi on Whether Your Savings Account Gets a Boost
items.summary: Goldman Sachs wants the Fed to hike again while Citi calls for three cuts starting in October, and the gap between those two forecasts could quietly drain hundreds of dollars a year from your savings account.

items.title: Large U.S. banks face rising G-SIB buffers and tighter excess capital: GS
items.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs believes the largest U.S. banks are likely to moderate capital deployment as regulatory buffers rise for a third consecutive year and excess capital levels shrink.

items.title: Elon Musk Says AI Could Add $20-$30 Trillion a Year to the Global Economy
items.summary: Elon Musk brought a staggering AI economic forecast to G20 policymakers, but Wall Street skeptics are raising pointed questions about the gap between today's debt-fueled buildout and the payoff Musk envisions.

items.title: Why Friday’s Jobs Report Could Surprise the Fed and Shock Markets
items.summary: The Federal Reserve is increasingly expected to raise interest rates in September, but signs of labor-market softness are putting new focus on Friday’s jobs report.
